text:
rana: idea: add a "staging lanes" primitive for config commits. lanes = short-lived activation windows with tunable sampling, quotas, and rollback heuristics. goal: simpler safe-rollout UX for routing + quota changes.

leo: can you sketch the API surface?

rana: POST /configs/commit?lane=staging.{name} with body {commit_id, lanespec: {duration_mins, sample_pct, quota_factor, redaction_level}}. system creates a lane_instance_id and activates routes into a soft state.

amy: what does "soft state" mean operationally?

rana: routing enforces quota_factor (e.g., 0.5) for matching routes and splits overflow to a configured fallback variant. Also we mirror a fraction of live requests to the lane telemetry pipeline for delta analysis.

leo: telemetry: we need per-route p95/p99, error delta, token-cost delta, and a new signal: quota_truncation_rate (how often requests were limited by the factor).

amy: aggregator should compute delta vs baseline window and produce a compact status: PASS/WARN/FAIL plus numeric score for console.

ops-bot: checklist: add RBAC scopes configs.commit.lane, configs.lane.action, telemetry.lane_v1. add retention TTL for lane reports (default 7d).

harry: privacy concern: this mirrors payloads. require masked payloads and default to headers-only unless operator sets redaction_level=none. also must support k-anon sampling.

rana: agreed. default redaction_level=mask. lane activation requires operator ACL and a small budget check if sample_pct > 5%.

leo: how do we handle multi-route commits where some routes in the lane are ok and others fail?

rana: lanes emit per-route verdicts. promotion policy: either manual per-route promote, or auto-promote-safe-only if org opts in. default = manual.

amy: auto-backoff: lane should auto-pause promotion when p95_delta>10ms OR error_increase>0.5% OR quota_truncation_rate>2%. notify @oncall.

harry: need idempotency: lane_instance_id must be stable for retries. propose lane_instance_id = HMAC(commit_id + lane_name + seed). also store the sampling seed so re-fetching the same lane yields same preview sample.

leo: storage: signed lane report (immutable) appended to config-ledger with operator id, git sha, and preview metrics. console can fetch signed_report_url.

amy: UI: show diff for routes/quotas, compact score, per-route mini-graphs, and promote/rollback buttons. include a link to raw signed report and retention TTL.

ops-bot: note: add a small e2e harness that can drive synthetic traffic and assert auto-backoff. add unit tests for idempotency and redaction knobs.

rana: one more: allow re-run of lane preview against a new baseline without changing commit_id. POST /configs/lane/{lane_instance_id}/rerun?baseline_ts=xxx. rerun gets new lane report but same lane id.

harry: retention and replay: limit reruns to 3 per lane and keep rerun chain in ledger. security: rerun requires configs.lane.rerun scope.

leo: solid. timeline? small RFC + PoC this week?
ama: i'll write RFC tonight and a tiny PoC that returns a signed lane report sample. thanks all. :rocket:
